user_prompt:
What is the effect of a child-feeding intervention, compared with no-intervention control,
on children's vegetable intake, measured short-term (less than 12 months after the
intervention)? Pool as a standardized mean difference, since studies use different vegetable
intake measures. Do not include longer-term follow-up data — that is a separate outcome in
this review.
